svg.title: What the product does
svg.text: MPX BOIL-LOOP MINI V0.5 · DESIGN REVIEW

text.tspan: A bottle-sized purifier on USB-C. It pumps water through thin steel tubes, holds it at a boil so dissolved lime crusts around microplastics, catches the
crust while hot, then cools the water with its own heat exchanger.
Pour 0.5 L into the glass jug and plug in a 65 W USB-C charger or
power bank. A peristaltic pump pulls
Cold water climbs the outer tube of a 2.4 m tube-in-tube exchanger
by the water coming back down. A
heater adds the last few degrees.
at the boil in a vented 61 mL coil. Calcium bicarbonate
loses CO₂ and comes out as lime, which crusts around plastic
steel mesh in a twist-out drawer catches the crust. A wax
gate only opens above 92–95 °C. The exchanger and the body coil
2.73 kg dry. The concept sheet said 1.3 kg; the
USB-C PD 20 V, 60 W heater; about 23 W once
90 % at 285 mg/L hardness; about 40 % at 80 mg/L
PharMed pump tube on the cold side
7 parts, no PCB, battery or sensor; wax gate and
Not costed for v0.5. v0.4 BOM: ₹14,890 prototype,
